annotations.title: Fill the user’s answers into a job’s application form

description: Use this when the user has answered the open questions of a job’s application form (Bewerbung) in the chat. Fills the answers (by `kennung`: a text, one of its `auswahlwerte`, a list for multiple choice) into the form open in the Jobroulette app and stores them for when the user opens it later. Only the user’s own answers; `nur_pro` fields are refused. Returns per answer whether it was set, and which required fields are still empty. Submits nothing: the user ticks consents and submits in the app. Scope: bewerbung:senden.
name: set_form_fields
title: Fill the user’s answers into a job’s application form
